batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved scan of the JU D Unit 2011-2012 paper in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-d-2011-2012-set1.pdf (7 pp.). The printed header (p.1) reads: ঘ ইউনিট (জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ), ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১১-২০১২, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; সময়ঃ ১ ঘণ্টা, পূর্ণমান- ১০০; boxed 'SET CODE: 1' — the Drive listing label 'Set-1' AGREES with the printed code (no listing-vs-printed discrepancy), so the paper id is ju-d-2011-2012-set1. The header names no single subject and the compilation prints no subject headings; the 100 questions (the header itself states মোট প্রশ্ন ১০০টি) run in printed blocks — Chemistry Q1-40, Biology Q41-90 (Zoology Q41-65, Botany Q66-90, carried as topics under subject 'Biology' per the project JU D convention), Bangla Q91-94, English Q95-98, General Knowledge Q99-100 — and subjects are assigned by content/block accordingly (Q35-36 and Q39-40 are biochemistry-flavoured but sit inside the uninterrupted Chemistry block, with the pure-chemistry calculations Q37-38 between them). Key form: a ব্যাখ্যা box plus a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key per question, X a LATIN letter A-D matching the options' Latin A-D labels; Q91-100 carry only the boxed key with no ব্যাখ্যা. All 100 questions are keyed; ONE dual key (Q18, box prints 'B+C'); 0 keyless; 0 printed no-correct-option dispositions. Two key boxes contradict their own ব্যাখ্যা (Q56, Q57) — the boxed key is recorded in both cases and the conflict documented in the questions' extractionNotes. Extraction-stage pack: content and answers unverified pending cross-source verification; the printed keys are the compiler's, not an official JU key. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: CamScanner scan of a compiler-solved reprint (per-question ব্যাখ্যা box with a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key; keys and option labels use Latin letters A-D). Aggregator footer 'For More Question Bank Visit www.admissionwar.com', diagonal 'Admission War' watermarks and 'Scanned by CamScanner' footers are the aggregator's/scanner's, not part of the question paper. Two-column layout. Transcription by direct visual reading of 300-dpi page renders (ocr/pages/ju1112ds1/p-1..7.png; p-1 render sha256 0d75b3d6a54a4bae8306ef08b0e2eeaf845ac2ac0abc9eabc9c3c1b98dc3ebad; all seven renders hash-verified against a second independent render after a concurrent parent render job corrupted the first p-3 file — the corrupted copy was replaced with the verified render, sha256 68e13071cebb79f2aaa743a1afc935235248bf0b8aeff69b990b978dc4c368ab), checked on 1400px overviews and quadrant crops of every page; quadrant crops match the overviews of the same pages. Spillovers: Q5's ব্যাখ্যা and key box are at the top of p.1's right column; Q16's ব্যাখ্যা and key box are at the top of p.2's right column; Q44's ব্যাখ্যা and key box are at the top of p.4's right column; Q58's ব্যাখ্যা and key box are at the top of p.5's right column; Q66's ব্যাখ্যা and key box are at the top of p.6; Q82's ব্যাখ্যা and key box are at the top of p.7; Q89's ব্যাখ্যা and key box are at the top of p.7's right column. Question page numbers in the pack are the pages where the stems are printed. Several ব্যাখ্যা boxes contain drawn structures/diagrams (Q2, Q9, Q10, Q20, Q22-25); all stems and options themselves are text, so no question is flagged as a figure question.
